hero.eyebrow: Confidential by default · The key owns the account
hero.body: The NFT is the viewing key. The account trades inside an attested enclave. Hold the key, run the account. Sell it, and the account goes with it.

how.title: Three steps. One signature.
how.s1d: Google or email (we create a NEAR account for you), any NEAR wallet, or MetaMask. Named or implicit account. No KYC.
how.s2d: One gas-free signature (NEAR NEP-413 or MetaMask EIP-191). The TEE-held minter pays and mints the NFT to you.
how.s3d: Signed requests run inside Intel TDX. Caps are checked there, with an attestation for every call.
how.gasfree: Signing a message costs no gas and moves no funds.

proof.title: Proof, not promises
proof.sub: Every claim on this page links to a mainnet transaction or a TEE attestation.

vault.title: Your confidential account
vault.sub: Fund, trade and withdraw with one signature each. The enclave checks the signature, the nonce and your caps.
vault.need: Connect a wallet to open your vault.
vault.utc: Daily caps reset at 00:00 UTC ({time} your time).
vault.keyLogEmpty: No events for this key yet.
vault.keyLogOld: This enclave build does not serve the key log yet.
vault.storageNote: If this account has not held this token, NEAR registers storage once (about 0.00125 NEAR, about $0.006), taken from the amount.
vault.dry: Dry quote: no deposit address, no funds move.
vault.nokey: You don't hold a key yet.
vault.holderOnly: Only the key holder can open this
vault.holderOnlyBody: This wallet does not hold a key yet. A key is a free NFT that opens your own private account in the enclave: minting costs one signature and no fee (the enclave pays the NEAR storage). Until then, fund, trade and withdraw stay closed.
vault.accountD: One private wallet per key, created and held inside the TEE. Whoever holds the key operates it. Balances are read with your signature; nothing is published on-chain.
vault.balanceReal: Read from the enclave with your signature.
vault.balanceSession: Read from the enclave with your session.
vault.sealedBook: Balances stay sealed until you sign a read.
vault.fundLead: Ask the enclave for a deposit address, then send the amount to it from any NEAR wallet or exchange that sends on the NEAR chain. Funds move only when you send them.
vault.tradeLead: A quote first, then one signature. The enclave prices the trade and checks your caps before anything moves.
vault.capRefused: A refused or failed attempt still counts toward today's cap until it resets.
vault.limitsUnread: Sign once to read your caps.
vault.withdrawLead: Sends to {account}, the account you connected. The enclave checks the signature, the nonce, your tier caps and the rate limit, then withdraws from your confidential account.
vault.hiddenLog: The log stays hidden until the attestation names the worker active on the OutLayer registry now.
vault.logPrevious: Previous build: this call ran a genuine earlier published worker, not the current one. The log stays hidden.
vault.logQuoteUnverified: Registry match, but the Intel quote could not be verified in this browser, so the log stays hidden.
vault.myLimitsNote: Set your own caps under the tier caps. The enclave enforces them on every trade and withdraw.
vault.limitsNow: In force: {tx} per trade · {day} per day
vault.cooldown: This key changed hands recently. Withdraw opens at {time} UTC. Trades still work.
vault.meterTxNone: Cap per single trade. Nothing has been spent; get a quote to preview how much of it a trade would use.
vault.meterTx: Preview: this quote would use {pct}% of the per-trade cap. Nothing is spent until you swap.
vault.limHelp: Tier max {tx} per trade, {day} per day. A cut applies at once; a raise waits 24 hours.
vault.destHelp: Your wallet signs this exact address.
vault.activityHint: Sign a read to see your recent trades and withdrawals.
vault.pnlHelp: Opt-in. The enclave signs a pointer to your swap log (key, trade count, log head). Open Activity and /verify for each trade’s inputs, outputs, quote and receipt. No profit number.
vault.lockNote: This key is locked for sale until {time} UTC. Trades and withdrawals resume then, or after a transfer.

mint.title: Mint your key
mint.sub: Minting is free. You sign once, and the enclave pays the storage.
mint.forged: Forged from its traits, minted on NEAR mainnet. No other key looks like this one.
mint.capsLine: {finish} tier: up to {tx} a trade and {day} a day
mint.bronzeOnly: Minting today issues a Bronze key. Silver and Gold are earned by trading. Legendary is a cosmetic Gold finish, not a fourth cap. Borrow caps while lending is off: 0.05 NEAR, 0.5 NEAR and 5 NEAR.

verify.title: Verify the enclave
verify.sub: Paste a call id. Your browser fetches the Intel TDX attestation from OutLayer, downloads the exact wasm from on-chain FastFS storage and hashes it locally. No trust in this site required.
verify.placeholder: call id (or a NEAR tx hash), e.g. e805f050-…
verify.match: Code hash matches the published worker
verify.nomatch: Code hash does NOT match the published worker
verify.script: Or run the script in the repo:
verify.lead: Six attestation checks, 19 Intel DCAP checks and 12 Intel revocation and TCB checks, done locally against the enclave's attestation, Intel's signed data and NEAR mainnet. Nothing here asks you to trust this site.
verify.quoteD: OutLayer attestation · quote parsed in your browser
verify.hashD: Registered hash equals the hash that executed, then your browser re-hashes the wasm.
verify.pubD: The wasm bytes come from on-chain FastFS.
verify.bindD: report_data {rd}… equals sha256 of task, wasm, input and output hashes, caller and time, recomputed in your browser
verify.bindWait: report_data in the TDX quote is recomputed from the attested fields
verify.outBad: {src} output does NOT hash to output_hash
verify.outNone: Optional: paste the worker output below to check it against output_hash
verify.pasteLabel: Worker output (JSON) to check against output_hash
verify.isTx: That is a NEAR transaction hash, not an enclave call. Transactions are verified by the chain itself:
verify.fetchFail: The attestation could not be fetched.
verify.genuinePrev: Genuine enclave, previous build (not the current one).
verify.pcsDown: Intel PCS did not answer. {n} of 25 attestation and DCAP checks passed here; press Run again for the 12 PCS checks.
verify.hashesNote: Two different hashes, by design: executed_wasm_sha256 is the sha256 of the KEYHOLE worker wasm that ran (compare it with tee/worker/DEPLOYED_SHA256). worker_measurement is the TDX runtime measurement of OutLayer's worker image, the RTMR3 register inside this quote. It names the enclave, not the KEYHOLE code.
verify.dcapH: Intel DCAP, checked in your browser
verify.tamperD: Change one byte or field of this call in your browser and watch the checks that guard it turn red.
verify.tallyH: {n} of {total} checks passed in this browser
verify.tallyD: 6 against NEAR mainnet, 19 Intel DCAP, 12 revocation and TCB. No server of ours is trusted.
verify.dcapNote: Parses the TDX quote, verifies the quote signature, the Quoting Enclave report and the PCK chain up to the pinned Intel SGX Root CA, and checks report_data against the attested fields. Revocation and TCB status are checked in the next section.
verify.pcsAdv: Intel advisories for this TCB level: {ids}
verify.pcsNote: Fetches Intel's PCK and Root CA revocation lists, the TDX TCB Info for this machine's FMSPC and the TD Quoting Enclave identity from Intel PCS, through a pass-through on this site because Intel sends no CORS headers. Every signature is checked here against the pinned Intel SGX Root CA, then the TCB level is matched as Intel's verifier does. The status is shown as Intel reports it.
verify.bindReq: Answer bound to key {token}, request sha256 {req}…, nonce {nonce}…

footer.tagline: Nothing on the chain. Everything in the key.

minter_payout_unregistered: The minter payout slot is not registered.
The operator must explicitly pay the exact permanent payout-storage fee before minting. No sponsorship was charged.
collateral_unknown: Keep the original transaction hash and reconcile it. Do not register or fund again.
collateral_audit: The signed collateral review was refused.
Request a fresh team review for the exact policy and current owner epoch.
collateral_policy: The collateral policy is not the reviewed template.
Stop enrollment and compare the exact sealed policy, guardian and wallet identity.
collateral_quote: The collateral storage quote exceeds the signed budget.
Read the current storage quote and obtain a new bounded authorization before installation.
evidence: Custody evidence is missing or inconsistent.
Stop and reconcile the original creation, install and separate post-install review. Do not rebind.
guardian: The guardian liveness proof was refused.
Use a fresh context-bound NEP-413 challenge signed by the current guardian FullAccess key.
exit_quote_unavailable: A usable exit preview is unavailable.
Do not withdraw or fund a loan. Check the documented route and actual destination receipts.
inventory_changed: The wallet authority inventory changed during review.
Stop enrollment and inspect the complete current request and approval inventory.
inventory_unavailable: The complete wallet authority inventory could not be read.
Wait for a complete authenticated inventory. Never assume missing pages are empty.
native_busy: A native operation is already pending.
Reconcile the original operation before starting another one.
native_unknown: The native operation outcome is unknown.
Recover the original signed hash and FINAL receipts. Do not resend.
native_blocked: The operation was refused before anything was sent.
Reconcile the original operation before starting another one. Do not resend.
rpc_unavailable: The chain view is unavailable or malformed.
Wait for a valid FINAL response. An unavailable response does not prove absence.
withdraw_minimum_required: A signed withdrawal minimum and deadline are required.
Do not execute. Review destination, asset, amount, minimum and deadline together.
withdraw_quote_expired: The signed withdrawal deadline is missing or expired.
Stop. A fresh preview alone cannot bind the provider execution.
withdraw_execution_unavailable: Preview is advisory only. Stop for a separately approved slippage/fee policy; do not fund or enable lending.
admission_unknown: Keep the existing operation ID. Reconcile that admission before sending or opening another operation.
certificate: This collateral certificate is not valid for the current offer.
Read the exact offer and refresh its same-terms certificate. Do not fund a changed or expired statement.
collateral_ineligible: This account has not passed the custody checks for this offer.
Do not fund. Verify the wallet, settled prior operations and approved authority audit first.
cooldown_state: The ownership cooldown could not be verified.
Do not withdraw or reset the record. Wait for storage and final-chain reads to recover, then read status again.
destination_policy: Use a supported chain and your authenticated holder account. Sessions and other destinations cannot withdraw.
epoch_changed: The key changed hands after this request was signed.
Read its current owner and ownership epoch. Only the current holder may sign a new request.
guard_journal: The saved operation does not match this account or request.
Keep its original ID and body. Do not create a replacement send; inspect the existing operation first.
guard_state: The guarded account state is unavailable or inconsistent.
Do not send value. Verify the current contract, canonical wallet and minter configuration first.
legacy_versions: The approved worker registry is not exclusive.
New value operations are paused until the canonical registry is verified. Do not bypass the version check.
needs_review: The custody outcome is not yet known.
Keep the original operation ID and reconcile it. Do not resend, refund or assume failure because time passed.
pledged: This key is pledged; its account is locked.
Read the loan state. Trading and exits stay blocked until the valid loan resolution and confirmed thaw.
quote_changed: The executable quote no longer matches the preview.
Check the existing operation status, then request a fresh preview before authorizing another quote.
session_epoch: This session belongs to an earlier ownership epoch.
Sign in again as the current holder to create a new scoped session.
transfer_pending: This key transfer is still provisional.
Wait for committed acceptance or the contract-supported provisional-title restoration. Private access is unavailable meanwhile.
unsupported_authority: This signing authority is not supported in this release.
Use a supported holder-authorized operation. Arbitrary detached signing is disabled.
value_op_pending: An admitted value operation is still pending.
Reconcile its original operation ID before trading, transferring the key or opening a pledge.
account_mismatch: Reconnect the same account and sign again.
already_holder: This account already holds a key.
already_minted: This account already minted a key.
bad_nonce: Sign again; a fresh nonce is used each time.
bad_params: Some details were missing or invalid.
bad_public_key: Your wallet sent an unsupported key.
Use an ed25519 full-access key wallet.
bad_signature: Sign again with a full-access key.
expired: The signature is older than 5 minutes.
Your clock may be off; sign again.
key_not_owned: That key isn't on this account on-chain.
Use the account that owns the key.
mint_failed: Nothing was charged to you. Try again.
minter_low_balance: The minter account is short on NEAR.
Minting is paused until that account is topped up. Your wallet was not charged.
bad_log: The key log does not verify.
Do not trust the rows. Run the verify-log script on the published head.
no_key: You don't hold a key yet.
locked: This key is locked for sale.
Swap and withdraw resume when the lock ends or the key is transferred.
listed: This key is listed for sale, so the enclave has frozen swaps and withdrawals on it.
Unlist the key to swap or withdraw again. Nothing was sent.
epoch_void: This key changed hands while the payout was still in flight, so the enclave voided it.
Nothing was sent. Ask again as the current holder if you still want the transfer.
not_listed: A key's record is public only while it is listed for sale.
Nothing was signed. Read the key's provenance instead, or wait for a listing.
not_owner: Only the current key holder can do this.
The key moved before this request settled. Nothing was sent.
op_mismatch: The signed action doesn't match the request.
over_cap_daily: Wait for the UTC reset or upgrade your tier.
over_cap_per_tx: That trade is over your per-trade cap ({cap}).
Lower the amount or upgrade your tier.
mint_quota: Today's free mints are used up.
The daily quota resets at 00:00 UTC; try again then.
busy: The enclave is busy right now.
Wait a few seconds and sign again.
quote_moved: The price moved above the checked quote.
Nothing was committed; request a new quote.
chainsig_quota: This key reached today's Chain Signatures limit.
replay: Each request needs a fresh signature; sign again.
entropy: Secure event randomness is unavailable; no commitment was published.
Check the original operation status before resuming. Do not submit another money operation to repair its history.
storage: The enclave could not confirm storage.
Check the original operation status before resuming. Do not repeat a money operation to repair its history.
upstream: The routing network didn't return a price.
Try a different pair or amount.
wallet_no_sign_message: Use a NEAR wallet that can sign messages, or MetaMask.
metamask_next_enclave: Vault actions with MetaMask arrive with the next enclave version.
You can connect now. Mint, trade, and withdraw open once that version is live.
wallet_popup_blocked: Your browser or an ad blocker stopped the wallet window.
Allow pop-ups for this site and pause the ad blocker here, then try again.
wrong_recipient: The signature was made for a different app.
empty: Your balance is empty for that token.
policy_denied: The enclave policy refused this action.
Lower the amount or check your tier limits.
still_minter: This enclave is still the active minter.
service_unfunded: The service's TEE compute balance is empty.
We're topping it up; try again soon. Your keys and funds are unaffected.
cooldown: Withdraw opens 10 minutes after the transfer. Trades inside the account still work.
session_expired: Unlock again with one wallet signature.
session_revoked: Unlock again with one wallet signature.
session_unknown: The enclave doesn't know this unlock.
Unlock again with one wallet signature.
session_scope: Raising limits, locking a key and proofs always ask for a fresh signature.
session_cap: This unlock's $5 spending cap is used up.
Unlock again, or confirm in your wallet.
session_token: This unlock is for another key.
Unlock the key you are using.
bad_session: Lock and unlock again with one wallet signature.
session_too_long: An unlock can last at most 30 minutes.
Unlock again; the site asks for 30 minutes.
withdraw_version: This worker cannot execute the signed exact-exit protocol.
Use a reviewed exact_near_exit_v1 worker. Never re-sign as legacy withdraw.
exit_receipt: Original FINAL FT delivery proof is not yet verified.
Reconcile the same request; supply the original transaction locator if archival lookup needs it. Never send another exit.
exit_continue: The original unsent hop needs fresh bounded consent.
Check the original exit and confirm only its unchanged next hop.

offline.title: The enclave is resting
offline.body: KEYHOLE's TEE compute is temporarily offline while it's topped up. Your keys, account and funds are safe on-chain, and nothing you sign is sent until it's back.

empty.vaultBody: Connect a NEAR wallet or MetaMask. Reading your vault costs one gas-free signature that only the enclave can check.
empty.mintBody: Connect, sign once, and the TEE-held minter mints your viewing key. No gas, no sign-up.
empty.verifyTitle: Three checks, all in your browser
empty.c1d: Intel TDX hardware quote is present in the attestation.
empty.c2d: The registered wasm hash equals the hash that actually executed.
empty.c3d: Your browser downloads the wasm from FastFS and hashes it itself.

land.lead: Your key is an NFT on NEAR. Behind it sits a private trading account inside a sealed enclave. Whoever holds the key controls the money. Sell the key and the account moves with it; the seller is refused on their next request.
land.s1: Keys held on mainnet (test key excluded)
land.ring: HOLD THE KEY · OPEN THE PRIVATE BOOK · SELL IT · THE BOOK MOVES · INTEL TDX · ONE OF ONE ·
land.b1d: Mint a one-of-one key NFT on NEAR.
land.b2d: Balances and key history stay inside the enclave. Swap pairs and amounts go to 1Click solvers.
land.b3t: Sell it, and the account moves
land.b3d: Transfer the key and its confidential balance goes with it. The seller can lock it first, and a buyer can check a signed balance proof.
land.howH: A key you hold. A book only
land.st1d: Your tier sets per-trade and daily caps. Your key is generated one of one.
land.st2d: Your wallet signs one gas-free message (NEAR NEP-413 or MetaMask EIP-191). The enclave verifies it and trades privately.
land.sealedD: Each key holds sealed credentials: its custody key lives only inside the Intel TDX enclave, acts only when the current on-chain owner signs, and moves to the buyer when the NFT is sold.
land.st3d: Sell the NFT. The new holder runs the same balance; you no longer can.
land.privLead: The public chain records who holds the key. Balances, positions and trade history live sealed inside the TEE, readable only with the key.
land.privAlt: A sealed enamel chest with a wax seal and its key
land.pubD: Token id and holder on NEAR. No balances, no trades.
land.sealD: Per-holder wallet, balances, history; the signing key never leaves encrypted TEE storage.
land.enclLead: Every answer comes with an Intel TDX attestation from OutLayer. Verify the quote and the worker code hash yourself, in your browser.
land.enclAlt: A sealed enamel reliquary with a wax seal
land.capD: Per-trade and per-day limits in USD, enforced inside the enclave.
land.sigD: Every request is signed by the holder's NEAR full-access key (NEP-413) or a MetaMask signature (EIP-191), checked in the TEE.
land.replayD: Each nonce is stored once. A replayed message is refused.
land.rateD: Per tier per minute, plus a global ceiling.
land.chainLead: NEAR Intents 1Click routes between assets like these across their chains. Inside the vault, a key's sealed account trades USDC and wNEAR on NEAR.
land.chainTry: Get a live quote with no wallet, and see real settled and refunded orders
land.tierLead: The tier sets the caps the enclave enforces and the metal of the key. Minting today issues Bronze. Legendary is a cosmetic finish of a Gold key, not a fourth cap.
land.galLead: Each token is generated from traits: head, filigree, enamel, gem, shaft engraving, tier finish and a bit cipher that encodes the token id.
land.concept: Silver and Gold are previews, not minted tokens.
land.conceptLive: See every live key on mainnet
land.agLead: Every vault action is a signed operation your agent or CLI can call. Same caps, same enclave, same attestation.
land.feat1d: Each trade is a signed call inside the enclave, with an attestation you can check.
land.feat2d: Balances and key history stay sealed in the enclave. Only the key holder can read them.
land.feat3d: Swaps route through NEAR Intents 1Click. Its solvers see the pair and the amount.
land.feat4d: Every key is one of one, with its own art, traits and bit cipher. Minting today issues Bronze.
land.utilLead: Caps, signatures, replay and rate limits are checked inside the enclave on every call.
land.noKeys: No keys could be read from NEAR just now. Reload to try again.

lp.proofLead: Each number opens the place where you can check it.
lp.handLead: One key, two holders. Each step is a real call or transaction, and its proof opens in one click.
lp.step1D: Holder A signs a withdraw. The enclave checks that A owns the key before it pays out.
lp.step2D: One NFT transfer on NEAR mainnet. The trading account goes with the key.
lp.step3T: A asks again, and is refused.
lp.step3D: The enclave reads the owner on every request. A no longer owns the key, so the call returns not_owner.
lp.handNote: Both wallets are team test wallets on mainnet. A payout already in flight when the sale lands still completes, to the holder who signed it.
lp.checkH: Check a key before you buy it.
lp.checkLead: Anyone can read the enclave's signed statement for a key. Your browser checks each part, with no wallet.
lp.checkNote: A layout example, not a live result. Run a real check on /key.
lp.checkSay: The enclave signed this statement, and the holder still holds the key on chain.
lp.ckSigD: ed25519 over the exact statement bytes, checked in your browser.
lp.ckMinterD: Compared with the minter the contract reports on NEAR.
lp.ckTokenD: The token id in the statement is the key you are looking at.
lp.ckOwnerD: The current holder, read from NEAR when you check.
lp.ckAgeD: When the enclave signed it, and how old that is.
lp.ckLogD: The enclave's log head at the time of signing.
lp.tradeLead: Swaps route through NEAR Intents 1Click, across {n} tokens on {m} chains.
lp.tradeLeadNoCount: Swaps route through NEAR Intents 1Click, across tokens on many chains.
lp.tradeNote: The count is read from the 1Click token list each time this page renders, at most once a minute.
lp.privLead: Balances and trade history stay sealed in the enclave. Here is what each side can see.
lp.enc1: Each key's custody wallet. It never leaves the enclave.
lp.enc3: Every request, checked against the current owner.
lp.pub1: The holder of each key and its token id, on NEAR.
lp.pub2: Each attested call, its result and the worker build that ran it.
lp.pub3: The swap pair and amount, to the 1Click solvers that route it.
lp.privLine: Keys to the money never leave the enclave.
lp.judgeH: Verify the live deployment in two minutes.
lp.judgeLead: No account and no wallet. The script reads public sources and writes nothing.
lp.ctaH: Hold the key. Sell the account.
